title: Escape My Room
specs: Escape rooms inspired by the historic Delaporte mansion
2019 Skeleton Key Award for Best Overall Storytelling
2019 Skeleton Key Award for Most Innovative Escape Room: Smuggler’s Den
All ages allowed if accompanied by an adult; children over 2 must have a ticket
Recommended ages 12+ for Mardi Gras Study, 16+ for Jazz Parlor and Smugglers Den

Illustrated guidebook for The Nutcracker experience
gap: Maximum group size per room not explicitly stated
blurb: Guests solve puzzles and uncover mysteries in themed escape rooms inspired by the Delaporte mansion. The Nutcracker experience is a self-paced holiday adventure through multiple rooms with puzzles. All escape rooms are private except The Nutcracker, which is shared with other groups.
extraNote: No walk-ins; tickets must be purchased online at least 30 minutes in advance · Arrive no more than 15 minutes early or 5 minutes late · All ticket sales are final; refunds only for COVID-19 symptoms with immediate contact · Guests may not bring more than the maximum allowed per room; extra guests pay $28 on arrival · Guests can leave rooms anytime; doors remain unlocked · Masks optional as of Sept 1, 2022; highly recommended indoors · Enhanced cleaning and staggered schedules to reduce contact · 1152 Camp St., former funeral home near the World War II Museum
